ggutils

Small, reusable utilities for ggplot2.

ggutils adds helpers that plug into the usual grammar – no new geometry, no special data format.

guide_axis_smart(): readable labels on crowded axes

Picks the labels you want, spreads them over several rows / columns so they never overlap, and draws a leader line from every label back to its tick.

ggplot(d, aes(gene, value)) + geom_col() +
  guides(x = guide_axis_smart(n = 8))

guide_axis_cluster(): dendrograms on the axes

Clusters the categories, orders the axis by the dendrogram and draws the tree next to it. position moves the tree only; free facets get one tree per panel; on coord_radial() it becomes a ring tree.

ggplot(d, aes(gene, sample, fill = z)) + geom_tile() +
  scale_x_cluster(method = "ward.D2") +
  scale_y_cluster(position = "left")

facet_gridn(): per-panel free scales for facet_grid() 

ggplot(d, aes(gene, value)) + geom_point() +
  facet_gridn(rows = vars(cluster), cols = vars(set), scales = "free_x")

coord_spiral(): Cartesian plots on a spiral

Bends a normal ggplot into an Archimedean spiral and draws the angle and radial axes for you.

ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) + geom_line() + coord_spiral(turns = 3)

Installation

Requires R >= 4.1 and ggplot2 >= 4.0.0.

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("junjunlab/ggutils")

Credits

The overlap-free label compaction is a port of smartAlign from circlize; the box arrangement is a port from ComplexHeatmap. The ggplot2 guide integration is new.
